checks.detail: Timeline input fails closed without Approved Creative Brief and Variant Plan pointers.
Beat, clip, crop, rhythm and narration plans use versioned typed contracts.
Selection refuses rights-blocked or ungrounded fill and reports coverage gaps.
Creative output assembles into the canonical Master Timeline and existing semantic Patch/CAS boundary.
Full demo comparison for rhythm, narration, continuity and crop awaits real approved Story/Strategy data.
No real Timeline Intent has received editor checkpoint approval.
E06 semantic visual providers remain unqualified for production selection/reframe.
Real multi-variant planning, Worker restart and full preview load require approved real input.

severe_errors.description: Selected clip does not support its narrative beat.
Missing required footage is silently filled with unrelated material.
A rights-blocked source enters the approved timeline.
A required dialogue or action is cut before comprehension.
Narration changes unsupported identity, event, causality or motivation.
Narration repeatedly restates clearly audible dialogue without purpose.
Crop removes a key face, action, text or violates safe composition.
Required minimum beat durations exceed the approved target.
